name: browser-use
headline: SDD Skill - Guides Spec-Driven Development
short_description: The SDD skill guides users through GitHub's Spec-Kit and Spec-Driven Development methodology. It helps operations teams create clear specifications, automate workflows, and improve collaboration. Connects to GitHub, Python, and Claude agents.
author: SpillwaveSolutions

sections.overview:
The SDD skill guides users through Spec-Driven Development, GitHub's methodology that transforms specifications into working implementations. It supports greenfield projects (new builds from scratch) and brownfield projects (existing codebases needing modernization or enhancement). The skill automates feature tracking with automatic progress visualization, dependency management, and status dashboards. Teams can manage features with natural language commands—add, reorder, and track requirements without manual updates. It integrates with the specify-cli tool to generate project constitutions, technical plans, task breakdowns, and implementation guidance, helping operations teams collaborate more effectively and reduce specification-to-code gaps.
Initialize new projects with executable specifications and architectural principles
Reverse-engineer and modernize existing codebases into SDD format
Track feature progress automatically through Specified, Planned, Tasked, In Progress, and Complete states
Manage feature dependencies and identify blocking items in team workflows
- **Project**: [Project Name]
- **Company**: [Company Name]
- **Industry**: [Industry Sector]
- **Objective**: [Project Objective]
